_comment: Every number here must be traceable to the cited source. Values marked verify:true must be checked against the source before submission. See docs/sustainability.md.

gcp_min_watts_per_vcpu.source: CCF methodology, GCP min watts (SPECpower average)

gcp_max_watts_per_vcpu.source: CCF methodology, GCP max watts (SPECpower average)

avg_cpu_utilisation.source: CCF default assumption when utilisation is unknown

us-east1.source: Google Cloud region carbon data (grid gCO2eq/kWh)

asia-south1.source: Google Cloud region carbon data (grid gCO2eq/kWh)

runner_region.source: Assumption: GitLab.com hosted Linux runners run on GCP us-east1. Documented as an assumption.

server_kgco2e.source: CCF methodology, embodied emissions per server (approximate)

llm._comment: Reported separately as an uncertain line. Not included in the headline SCI.
